title: Inside the Atom: Protons, Neutrons and Electrons
summary: The three subatomic particles, atomic number, mass number, and how atoms become ions.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 8: Journey Inside the Atom (atomic number, mass number)

objectives: I can describe the charge, mass and location of protons, neutrons and electrons.
I can use atomic number and mass number to find the numbers of each particle.
I can explain how atoms become positive or negative ions.
misconceptions: Changing the number of neutrons or electrons changes the element (only protons do).
An atom with more electrons is a different element.
